feed.title: AeroAid · Scholarship directory updates
feed.subtitle: Public directory additions, including closed cycles and unverified leads. Check providers.

entry.title: Delta Zeta Continuing Education and Certification Grant
entry.summary: Delta Zeta Foundation — Up to 75% of program costs; $1,000 lifetime maximum. Initiated Delta Zeta members in good standing who have COMPLETED nondegree professional-development training, certification, licensure or an exam. The sponsor describes this as an alumnae grant for career advancement, career change or return to work. Education: traditional degree-program expenses are outside this grant; no specific previously earned degree or major is required in the published grant rules. Prior degree holders are not excluded. Apply within 90 days AFTER completion, with proof of completion and a current resume. AIM NJ tuition and FAA-specific licensing costs are not expressly confirmed; check the proposed training or exam before relying on this funding. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: PACIM Polanie Legacy Scholarship — reopening watch
entry.summary: Polish American Cultural Institute of Minnesota — Up to $2,000 in the closed 2026 cycle. Students of Polish descent enrolled or admitted to a postsecondary institution by September 1 under the published cycle rules. Technical and vocational schools are expressly eligible; no completed college degree, specific major or prior-degree exclusion is stated. Minnesota/Wisconsin residents and PACIM members receive PREFERENCE, not an exclusive residence rule. NJ applicants can check this route. Recipients are expected to volunteer at one PACIM event, either in person or REMOTELY. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Blue Umbrella Waterproofing & Foundations Scholarship
entry.summary: Blue Umbrella Waterproofing & Foundations — $500 per recipient. U.S. students age 16+ with Fall 2027 enrollment at an accredited college, university or vocational/trade school in an approved field. Fields include building technology/services, electrical, engineering technology, manufacturing, HVAC, plumbing, renewable energy, business/accounting/finance, design and related named fields. Education: degree or certificate study is accepted; no completed college degree or prior-degree exclusion is published. AIM NJ aircraft-maintenance study is not specifically listed and needs field confirmation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: John D. Unangst Memorial Scholarship
entry.summary: Franklin Mint Federal Credit Union Foundation — $4,500. Graduating high school seniors planning full-time study at an accredited two-/four-year college, university, trade, technical or business school. NJ residence must be in CAMDEN, GLOUCESTER or SALEM County; eligible PA counties are Delaware, Chester, Montgomery, Philadelphia and Bucks; eligible DE county is New Castle. Education: trade/technical study is accepted without a published associate-degree requirement or named major. No completed college degree is required; other prior-degree rules are not published. Current AIM enrollment alone does not satisfy graduating-senior status. Sponsor/affiliate employees, volunteers and immediate family are excluded. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: WFFC Flavor, Fragrance and She Works Scholarships
entry.summary: Women in Flavor & Fragrance Commerce — $5,000 per named scholarship. Women legally resident in the United States/DC, enrolled or accepted at an accredited postsecondary institution in a program specifically related to the FLAVOR OR FRAGRANCE INDUSTRY. Named fields include chemistry, biology, engineering, business, marketing, nutrition, food science, microbiology and cosmetics/fragrance marketing. The She Works route additionally requires employment in that industry while earning the relevant degree or CERTIFICATE. No previously completed degree or prior-degree exclusion is published. General aircraft-maintenance/AIM study is not confirmed for this industry-specific funding. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: SC&RF Vocational / Technical and Partner Training Scholarships
entry.summary: Specialized Carriers & Rigging Foundation — $250–$5,000 tuition support; partner training seats also available. For people working in, or preparing for, crane, rigging or specialized transportation careers. SC&RA membership and current industry employment are not required. Education: vocational training, certification and continuing-education courses from one day to several semesters; examples include diesel mechanics and welding. Four-year and master degree students use a different award. No previously completed degree requirement or exclusion is published. AIM aviation-maintenance study is not specifically confirmed for this industry-focused award. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Employee Ownership Foundation Trustee Scholars
entry.summary: Employee Ownership Foundation — $5,000 per year; renewal conditions apply. Detailed rules: age 22 or younger on February 12, 2027; employee or dependent child/stepchild of an employee at a corporate member of The ESOP Association in good standing. Part-time employees and employees not vested in the ESOP may qualify. Education: full-time study for the upcoming academic year at an accredited college or vocational-technical school. Certificates must last at least one semester/term, run on a STANDARD ACADEMIC SEMESTER calendar, and include enrollment when funds are disbursed in August. AIM NJ uses a 21-month academic program; its block calendar requires provider confirmation and is outside confirmed AIM matches. Graduate study excluded; prior-bachelor eligibility needs confirmation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: PTDA Foundation Employee Scholarship — reopening watch
entry.summary: PTDA Foundation — $2,500 in the closed 2026 cycle. Full-time employee of a North American power transmission/motion control distributor or manufacturer. Education: enrolled or accepted at a trade/technical school, college, university, continuing-education or relevant certification program in industry-related engineering, technology or business. No completed degree is required in the public description; no prior-degree exclusion is published. Aircraft-maintenance certificate relevance needs confirmation; current industry employment is mandatory. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: PTDA Foundation Student Scholarship — reopening watch
entry.summary: PTDA Foundation — $3,000 in the closed 2026 cycle. Enrolled or accepted trade/technical school, community college or university student in power transmission/motion control-related study, such as industrial engineering, distribution/manufacturing or mechatronics. Education: industry-relevant certifications, associate or undergraduate degrees; graduate study excluded. No completed degree is required; other prior-degree exclusions are not published. Current PT/MC industry employees are ineligible and should check the separate Employee Scholarship. AIM NJ aviation-maintenance certificate relevance needs confirmation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Wings Over America Navy Aviation Family Scholarships
entry.summary: Wings Over America Scholarship Foundation — $5,000; administered awards vary. Spouse, unmarried child or unmarried grandchild of qualifying U.S. Navy aviation personnel. Standard sponsor rule: eight years of qualifying active-duty/activated-reserve Navy aviation service; flight school does not count. Active-duty deaths in Navy aviation and certain command-specific administered awards have exceptions. Children and grandchildren must be age 23 or younger in the application year and study full-time (at least 12 credits per semester); spouses may study full- or part-time (at least 6 credits). Education: accredited trade/technical certification programs and college degrees are accepted. No completed college degree or prior-degree exclusion is stated. AIM NJ certificate students must document the required enrollment load and sponsor relationship. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: APIQWTC Certificate and Degree Scholarship
entry.summary: Asian Pacific Islander Queer Women & Transgender Community — $3,500 per recipient. Asian/Pacific Islander lesbian, bisexual or queer women, or Asian/Pacific Islander transgender or nonbinary individuals. Past recipients of either APIQWTC award are ineligible. Full- and part-time students and returning learners may apply. A San Francisco Bay Area connection is not required. Education: current or prospective Summer/Fall 2027 enrollment in a tuition-based certificate, associate, bachelor or graduate program at a U.S. NONPROFIT institution. No previously completed degree is required; no prior-degree exclusion is published. The nonprofit-school requirement excludes AIM NJ from confirmed matches. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Terri Higa Memorial Technical / Trade Scholarship
entry.summary: Asian Pacific Islander Queer Women & Transgender Community — $3,500. Asian/Pacific Islander lesbian, bisexual or queer women, or Asian/Pacific Islander transgender or nonbinary individuals. Past recipients of either APIQWTC award are ineligible. Full- and part-time students and returning learners may apply. A San Francisco Bay Area connection is not required. Education: pursuing an Associate of Science (AS) or Associate of Arts (AA) in a technical or trade career at an accredited U.S. NONPROFIT institution. Examples include automotive technology/collision repair, carpentry and allied health. A previously earned degree does not substitute for current eligible AS/AA study. No prior-degree exclusion is published. AIM NJ nondegree certificate study does not meet the degree and nonprofit-school rules. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: APIA Scholars Undergraduate Scholarships
entry.summary: APIA Scholars — $2,500 one-time to $20,000 over multiple years. Demonstrated high financial need. Education: full- or part-time DEGREE-SEEKING associate or bachelor enrollment at a U.S. accredited college/university in Fall 2027. Certificate-only vocational enrollment is not eligible. No prior bachelor or higher degree; an associate graduate pursuing a first bachelor may apply. Returning/adult students are welcome. All ethnicities and national origins may apply if the citizenship rule is met; being first-generation is not required. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Chugach Heritage Foundation Vocational Scholarship
entry.summary: Chugach Heritage Foundation — Up to $5,750 per calendar year. Original Chugach Alaska Corporation shareholders and direct lineal descendants who are registered in a recognized vocational, certificate or license-based training program. The vocational rules do not list a major, completed degree or Alaska-school requirement. Qualifying applicants should confirm their exact school, start date or term with CHF. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: CIRI Career Technical Education Scholarship
entry.summary: The CIRI Foundation — Up to $9,000 per calendar year. Original Cook Inlet Region, Inc. shareholders or lineal descendants with a high-school diploma or GED, enrolled in technical training at an accredited or recognized institution leading to a certificate, certification or occupational license. Requires a 2.0 term GPA; successfully completed prior vocational coursework can satisfy the published alternative. No completed college degree or specific technical major is required. Confirm individual school and term eligibility. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Oris W. and Sylvia M. Dunham Aviation Scholarship
entry.summary: AAAE Foundation — 2027–28 amount unpublished. Current students in aviation-related study at accredited U.S. or Canadian colleges, universities, technical/vocational schools or trade schools. The trade-school wording covers the type of accredited aviation-maintenance certificate offered at AIM NJ. No specific completed degree or AAAE membership is listed. Confirm the new cycle’s enrollment and school rules. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: GE Aerospace–Reagan Workforce Readiness Scholarship
entry.summary: Ronald Reagan Presidential Foundation and Institute / GE Aerospace — 2027 amount pending · prior awards up to $20,000. Students graduating high school in 2027 and entering technical education, vocational certification, skilled trades, two-year degrees or other eligible workforce training. Sponsor examples include aerospace, manufacturing and robotics. A completed degree is not required. The sponsor reserves 25% of awards for students from military households. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Burger King Scholars · vocational and employee pathways
entry.summary: Burger King Foundation / Scholarship America — $1,000–$60,000 across program awards. The General Track accepts 2027 graduating seniors or eligible past recipients for continuous full-time study throughout 2027–28 at an accredited school, including vocational-technical schools. The traditional Employee Track accepts qualifying employees, spouses, domestic partners and dependent children for continuous full- or part-time study. The separate enrichment option permits eligible employees or partners to take intermittent or less-than-part-time accredited certification courses. Traditional tracks require GPA 2.0 or equivalent. No specific vocational major is listed. Confirm whether your AIM NJ enrollment category and dates fit a track. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Milliman Opportunity Scholarship · U.S. program
entry.summary: Milliman / Scholarship America — Up to $5,000. U.S. residents who are high-school seniors or current postsecondary undergraduates. Must plan full-time undergraduate spring 2027 study at an accredited school. The detailed rules include vocational-technical schools and require a listed major such as computer science, programming, data science, mathematics or finance. Current graduate study is excluded. Aircraft maintenance is outside the published majors. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Sempra Employee Dependent Scholarship · vocational route
entry.summary: Sempra / Scholarship America — $1,500 for vocational study. Final-year high-school students age 19 or younger who are qualifying dependents or legal wards of regular full-time U.S. employees of Sempra or an eligible affiliate. GPA 3.0, community involvement and full-time study for the upcoming academic year at an accredited institution are required. Vocational-technical schools qualify. No completed degree or specific trade is listed. Sempra Infrastructure US and Mexico, officers and some other employee categories are excluded. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Moroccanoil Student Scholarship · cosmetology
entry.summary: Professional Beauty Association / Moroccanoil — $2,500. U.S. citizens age 18 or older currently enrolled in a cosmetology licensure program at an independent school without a product-brand affiliation. Existing cosmetology license holders and continuing education applicants are excluded. The rules require licensure study and no completed academic degree. This is specific to cosmetology. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Green Circle Salons Student Scholarship
entry.summary: Professional Beauty Association / Green Circle Salons — $2,500. Students age 18 or older enrolled in a U.S. or Canadian cosmetology or barbering licensure program. Existing industry license holders and continuing education applicants are excluded. The criteria specify licensure training and no completed academic degree. Aircraft maintenance is outside the field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Joseph L. Weir Memorial Scholarship · beauty trades
entry.summary: Professional Beauty Association / Joseph L. Weir Trust — $500. Current dues-paying PBA student members enrolled in recognized or accredited cosmetology programs, or licensed professional members pursuing eligible continuing education. No completed academic degree is listed. Licensing applies to the professional route. This award serves beauty trades. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Borboleta Pro Path Esthetics Scholarship
entry.summary: Beauty Changes Lives / Borboleta — Up to $1,500. Esthetics students and licensed professionals pursuing lash-artistry education. Prior administrator terms require proof of an eligible U.S. lash program or relevant licensure and exclude prior Beauty Changes Lives scholarship recipients. No completed degree is listed. Confirm the exact requirements on the upcoming form. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: JAN-PRO Your Family First Scholarship · vocational option
entry.summary: JAN-PRO / Scholarship America — Next amount unpublished. Under the last rules, qualifying JAN-PRO unit franchise owners in good standing for a year, their spouses, dependent children or grandchildren can apply. Employees of unit franchisees and regional developers and their listed family or staff cannot. Full- or part-time study at an accredited vocational-technical school qualifies under the education rule. Confirm whether the selected certificate and school meet the next application’s enrollment terms. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Carpenters Council Scholarship · vocational certificate
entry.summary: North Atlantic States Regional Council of Carpenters — Individual amount unpublished. Members in good standing and eligible dependent children from any council local. A grandchild qualifies only if the member is the legal guardian. Eligible children of members who recently died may apply under the published rule. The accredited program must run in fall 2027. Technical certificate or diploma study must be full-time and last at least six months. A C average and verified union activity are required. Graduate students and students pursuing a second bachelor’s are excluded. Confirm the selected AIM NJ certificate under the council’s final approval. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Coast Guard Foundation Spouse Grant · Fall 2026
entry.summary: Coast Guard Foundation — $1,000. Civilian spouses of active-duty enlisted Coast Guard members in grades E-1 to E-9 or enlisted Coast Guard Reservists in those grades on active-duty orders of 180 days or more. Current courses, certificates and professional certification study at a nationally or regionally accredited school can qualify, including accredited aviation-maintenance certificate study. No completed degree or named major is required. First degrees, licensure and certifications receive priority, as do spouses of members E-6 and below. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Fallen Heroes Scholarship · college or trade school
entry.summary: Coast Guard Foundation — Up to 100% of eligible education costs. Dependent children of enlisted or commissioned U.S. Coast Guard members who died in operational service. The Foundation explicitly includes higher education at trade schools and lists no specific major or completed degree. Confirm dependent status and your certificate program through the official application. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Coast Guard Foundation Enlisted Education Grant
entry.summary: Coast Guard Foundation — Up to $1,000 reimbursement. Active-duty enlisted personnel in grades E-3 through E-6. Reservists with over 180 days of active-duty orders in the prior 12 months may qualify. The general grant covers qualifying off-duty technical coursework and credentialing without a completed degree or specified major. Applicants must be participating in or have completed qualifying coursework within the last 12 months. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: First Tech | DCU STEM & Skilled Trades Scholarship
entry.summary: First Tech | DCU — $10,000. High-school seniors or current undergraduate or trade-school students planning full-time fall 2027 study in an approved STEM degree, credential or skilled-trade certificate at an accredited U.S. school. Requires GPA 3.5 or the published GED/HSE equivalent. Applicants in both tracks must be credit-union members in good standing. The employee track also requires a parent or legal guardian currently employed by First Tech | DCU. Prior program recipients are excluded under the applicable rules. Standalone AIM NJ A&P certificate eligibility requires confirmation. The FAQ lists some aviation-related majors, with no explicit aircraft-maintenance certificate entry. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Industrial Maintenance Scholarship · employment pathway
entry.summary: ELLWOOD — Up to $20,000 toward tuition. High-school seniors or GED completers who will pursue a certificate, diploma or degree in mechatronics or equivalent industrial maintenance. Recipients must start an approved program by the following January, maintain a 2.5 GPA, have reliable transport and meet employment screening. Published examples are outside NJ. ELLWOOD can approve other schools by written review. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance and any unlisted NJ school need approval. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Cape May Tech Post-Secondary Education Scholarship
entry.summary: Cape May County Chamber of Commerce Education Foundation — Amount unpublished. Cape May County residents enrolled in a post-secondary program at Cape May County Technical School. The current form requires a B or better, 95% attendance and punctuality, and a recommendation from someone outside the family. It lists no completed degree or specific major. The award is restricted to the named school’s post-secondary programs. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: College and Trade School Scholarship · graduating seniors
entry.summary: Cape May County Chamber of Commerce Education Foundation — Amount unpublished. Cape May County residents graduating high school in 2027 with a C average or better and the published attendance and conduct standards. The Foundation requires a qualifying employment or ownership connection to a Cape May County Chamber member business. The application accepts students planning trade school, with no stated completed degree or specific major. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Walter P. Krichling Jr. Vocational Scholarship
entry.summary: New Jersey Retirees’ Education Association — $1,500. 2027 graduates of a New Jersey public high school, including vocational-technical and public charter schools, with GPA 2.3 or higher and admission to a trade or vocational certification program. No completed degree or specific vocational major is listed. This is an entering-student route. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: James F. Anthony Scholarship · college or trade school
entry.summary: Big I New Jersey — $1,000. Dependents of current employees of active Big I New Jersey member agencies. Applicants plan to attend college, university or technical/trade school. The main description names seniors while the eligibility list also names juniors. Confirm school year with the sponsor. No specific trade or completed degree is listed. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: BTA Education Scholarships · trade-school route
entry.summary: Business Technology Association — $1,500–$3,000. Full-time employees of a current BTA member dealership, or their children, who study full time. BTA defines full-time employment as at least 30 hours weekly. The school rule lists accredited two- or four-year colleges, universities and technical/trade schools, and requires 12 college credits per semester, or nine for graduate students. No prior degree or particular major is listed. Confirm whether AIM NJ’s 21-month certificate and credit schedule meet those separate requirements. The related Patriot Pack category requires a qualifying veteran employee or their child or grandchild. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Tools for Success Scholarship · construction trades
entry.summary: ShareMyToolbox — Next amount unpublished. High-school seniors, current students and adult career changers enrolled or accepted into construction-related trade school, apprenticeships or degree programs. Applicants need an eligible ShareMyToolbox Business or Enterprise customer sponsor. No completed degree is required for the trade or apprenticeship route. Aircraft maintenance by itself is outside the construction field requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Career & Technical Education Award
entry.summary: Point Foundation — $2,000. LGBTQ+ students and allies enrolled or planning to enroll in an accredited career certificate or trade program, with at least one credit-bearing class in the funded spring term. AIM NJ’s 21-month, credit-bearing aviation maintenance certificate is the type of nondegree study described. Confirm your term enrollment and individual eligibility. Fully online programs and students currently pursuing an unrelated degree are excluded. No previously earned degree is required. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Educational Award
entry.summary: Catholic Order of Foresters — $600. Existing Catholic Order of Foresters members age 17 or older who attend or plan to attend an accredited college, trade or technical school. The application requires at least 15 months of membership in good standing before applying. Winners must supply proof of registration or attendance. Prior Educational Award or Fraternal Scholarship winners are excluded. Accredited certificate study can qualify without a completed degree or specified major. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Builders League of South Jersey Scholarship
entry.summary: BLSJ Scholarship Foundation — 2027 amount unpublished. Applicants must live or attend school in Atlantic, Burlington, Camden, Cape May, Gloucester, Salem or Cumberland County. Qualified full-time and part-time programs in home building, construction, remodeling or related fields can qualify, including trade school. Past recipients studied carpentry and HVAC. No completed degree is specified for the trade route. The published field is construction rather than aviation maintenance. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Workforce Credentials Scholarship
entry.summary: Council of College and Military Educators — $1,000. Current or former U.S. uniformed service members and eligible spouses or children. Applicants must be enrolled with a CCME member organization in a qualifying DoD SkillBridge program or a credential program validated by the U.S. Department of Labor or a State Apprenticeship Agency. Credit-bearing and nondegree paths are eligible. No completed degree is required for this category. Standalone AIM NJ enrollment does not establish the provider and validation requirements. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Manufacturing and Engineering Scholarships · matched application
entry.summary: SME Education Foundation — $2,500–$20,000. Graduating high-school seniors and students pursuing an associate, bachelor’s or graduate degree in manufacturing, engineering or a technical field that supports manufacturing. Full- and part-time study can qualify. The sponsor lists a 2.0 general minimum GPA, with individual award criteria varying. Applicants need a permanent U.S. or Canadian address. The portal matches students to individual awards, including awards for women. An AIM NJ certificate alone does not satisfy current degree study. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: JAHMA Resident Education Scholarship
entry.summary: JAHMA Foundation — Next amount unpublished. Residents of a participating JAHMA member property, including high-school seniors, graduates, GED holders and older adults. Accredited trade or professional schools are eligible under the prior rules. The sponsor lists no completed college degree or specific major. Document admission and check that your property and school qualify. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Precast Concrete Undergraduate Scholarship · certificate route
entry.summary: NPCA Foundation — $3,500 first year · up to $6,500 after internships. Applicants planning certificate or undergraduate enrollment for the next academic year in building, construction or precast concrete. No completed degree is required for the certificate route. The program must relate to these industries. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance by itself is outside those fields. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Building Hope Scholarship · construction trades
entry.summary: NAHB Professional Women in Building Council / National Housing Endowment — Next amount unpublished. Full- or part-time fall students at a college, university or trade school in a building-related course or vocational program, with at least one course or program remaining after the award. No completed degree is listed. The sponsor’s Building Hope rules do not list a women-only requirement. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance is outside the published field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Cobell Vocational & Trade Scholarship
entry.summary: Indigenous Education, Inc. — Up to $7,500 per calendar year. Enrolled members of a U.S. federally recognized American Indian Tribe or Alaska Native Corporation pursuing a vocational credential, certificate or occupational license at an accredited nonprofit institution. A second credential at the same level is excluded. The nonprofit school requirement excludes AIM NJ’s proprietary certificate. Eligible nonprofit NJ programs can qualify. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Jesse Brown Memorial Youth Scholarship
entry.summary: Disabled American Veterans — $2,500–$30,000. Volunteers 21 or younger with at least 100 hours credited through DAV or DAV Auxiliary. Self-nomination is allowed. Accredited vocational schools qualify, including an aviation maintenance certificate program that meets the institution rules. The sponsor lists no specific major, completed degree or degree-enrollment requirement. Applicants do not have to be veterans or dependents. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Charles Kosmutza Scholarship
entry.summary: Disabled American Veterans · New Jersey — $1,000. New Jersey high-school seniors with a qualifying natural or adopted family relationship to a DAV New Jersey member. Proof of relationship and membership is required. The sponsor accepts post-high-school trade, community college or college study and publishes no specific major or completed degree requirement. This route serves graduating seniors, including those planning trade school. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Purple Tassel Vocational Achievement Scholarship
entry.summary: Corvias Foundation — Up to $10,000. The sponsor announces the award for high-school seniors who are children of active-duty members assigned to Aberdeen Proving Ground, Fort Bragg, Fort Meade, Fort Polk, Fort Riley, Fort Rucker or Fort Sill at application or deadline. The form accepts planned or current vocational/technical certificate, license or degree study. No prior college degree or specific major is listed. Check the senior rule and exact school eligibility before assuming a current AIM NJ match. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Corvias Military Spouse Scholarship · certification route
entry.summary: Corvias Foundation — 2027 amount unpublished. Spouses of active-duty service members assigned to one of seven Corvias installations listed by the sponsor. The prior application accepts technical college, continuing education and license or certification study, with proprietary schools reviewed individually. No completed college degree or specific major was stated for certification. AIM NJ requires school and program approval. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: EmpowerHER Scholarship · women in electrical trades
entry.summary: IEC Foundation — Amount unpublished. Women students in good standing with an IEC chapter pursuing an electrical career. IEC Foundation describes electrical apprenticeships and other qualifying U.S. technical and college programs. NJ IEC is a chapter. No completed college degree is listed for the apprenticeship route. The award is for electrical training and does not cover AIM NJ aircraft maintenance. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: NJTMA Manufacturing and Technology Scholarship · confirm intake
entry.summary: New Jersey Technology and Manufacturing Association — $500–$1,000. Currently enrolled in manufacturing, engineering or technology training and sponsored by a current NJTMA member who writes a recommendation. The sponsor encourages members to nominate eligible employees. The public rules do not specify a completed college degree or limit awards to degree study. Confirm whether a specific aviation maintenance certificate qualifies. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Spark Your Success Scholarship · electrical industry
entry.summary: Van Meter Inc. — $1,000. High-school diploma or GED and current or planned electrical-industry apprenticeship, associate or undergraduate degree study. Examples include electrical distribution, renewables, construction management and engineering related to the electrical industry. The sponsor publishes no state restriction on the 2027 page. Confirm applicant location if the form adds a condition. Standalone AIM NJ A&P certificate study is outside the listed pathways. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Aviation Maintenance Apprenticeship · Pensacola intake check
entry.summary: ST Engineering Aerospace — Employee compensation · rate unpublished. High-school diploma or GED, mechanical or electrical aptitude, and ability to meet job physical requirements. Prior aircraft experience is preferred. The posting lists no A&P certificate or completed college degree requirement. One application covers structures, general aircraft maintenance, avionics and interiors assignments. The work and classroom training take place in Pensacola, Florida. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Aircraft Maintenance Operations Internship · degree enrollment
entry.summary: Envoy Air — $22/hour. Age 18+, GPA 3.0+, and current undergraduate or graduate degree enrollment in business, aviation management, analytics, information systems, engineering or a related field. Must be a junior, senior or graduate student by the start. AIM NJ certificate-only enrollment and a completed prior degree alone do not satisfy current degree enrollment. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Compassionate Care Scholarship · veterinary technician
entry.summary: HumaneVMA — $5,000. Current students in an AVMA-accredited U.S. veterinary technician program who plan to practice in the U.S. Eligible New Jersey veterinary technician programs include Bergen Community College. Applicants who graduated before November 2026 and prior recipients are excluded. No previously completed degree is listed. Aviation maintenance is outside the eligible field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: ASPCA Veterinary Technician Scholarship · reopening watch
entry.summary: ASPCA — Up to $20,000 total in 2026–27. The prior round required financial need, AVMA-accredited veterinary technician enrollment in year two or later, and a program that prepares graduates to sit for the licensing examination. Qualifying vocational and technical schools were accepted. Recipients are expected to work in animal welfare for at least three years after graduation. Aviation maintenance is outside the field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Professional Development Boost Grant · nonprofit careers
entry.summary: Women in Development – New Jersey — $250 reimbursement. Current WID-NJ members in good standing with at least two years of nonprofit-sector work. Eligible costs include certifications and courses supporting nonprofit professional development. No completed degree, college enrollment or gender restriction is stated in the published eligibility list. AIM NJ aviation study is outside the stated grant purpose unless the sponsor confirms a qualifying nonprofit career connection. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Aviation Maintenance Technician Internship · confirm intake
entry.summary: Corning — $1,635–$3,185 biweekly. Corning considers applicants actively pursuing an FAA Airframe or Powerplant mechanic certificate through an aviation maintenance program, including students in a program like AIM NJ’s. A certificate already earned is preferred. The posting lists no associate or bachelor’s degree requirement. Familiarity with tools, wiring diagrams and troubleshooting is expected. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Aircraft Maintenance Technician Intern / Co-op · degree enrollment
entry.summary: Marathon Petroleum — $20.31–$25.38 posted pay range. High-school diploma or equivalent and an Aviation Maintenance Technology, Aviation Maintenance Management or similar major. Part 147 A&P enrollment is preferred, but the employer requires concurrent degree-seeking enrollment throughout the internship. A four-year degree pathway is also available to already-certificated technicians. AIM NJ certificate-only study does not satisfy the stated degree condition. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Women in the Trades NABCEP Scholarship
entry.summary: HeatSpring and Solar for Women — Free training + $500 exam-fee reimbursement. Women working as solar installers, electrical apprentices or onsite technicians with at least six months of trades experience by the application deadline. The award covers photovoltaic installation training and the NABCEP PVIP credential. No college degree or major is specified. It does not pay for AIM NJ aircraft maintenance training or FAA exams. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Makers & Builders Award
entry.summary: NSHSS Foundation — $2,500. High-school seniors graduating in 2027 with a 3.0 unweighted GPA who plan to enroll by August 2027 in an accredited, state-approved or industry-recognized skilled trade, vocational certificate, technical credential or registered apprenticeship. No current college degree or NSHSS membership is required. An incoming AIM NJ student can check this vocational route. Current adult AIM enrollment alone does not meet the senior requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: U.S. JCI Senate Vocational Scholarship
entry.summary: U.S. JCI Senate Foundation — $1,000 or $1,500. Graduating 2027 U.S. high-school seniors with GPA 3.25 or higher who live in a participating state. New Jersey applicants have a designated state contact. Must begin full-time accredited U.S. trade or technical training in 2027. A certificate, diploma, license or associate degree route qualifies. Current AIM NJ enrollment alone does not satisfy the first-year-after-high-school rule. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Tia Maria Scholarship · Elizabeth high-school seniors
entry.summary: The Tia Maria Foundation — Award amount varies. Elizabeth Public Schools seniors graduating in spring 2027 who plan to attend college or trade school. The sponsored application does not require a completed degree or specify a trade-school major. The school district confirms the trade-school route. Applicants must meet the Elizabeth high-school requirement even if they plan to attend AIM NJ. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Foresters Renew Adult Education Reimbursement
entry.summary: Foresters Financial — Up to $1,000. Eligible Foresters members over 18 enrolled in a qualifying college or university class, an online adult-education class, or a license recertification course. This is course-level support for adult education and career growth. The public page does not require a completed degree or specified major. Confirm whether AIM NJ’s in-person certificate classes and initial FAA licensing costs qualify. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Foresters Competitive Scholarship · reopening watch
entry.summary: Foresters Financial — Up to $2,000 in 2026 rules. The last cycle accepted qualifying Foresters members or eligible family members pursuing a first postsecondary credential at an accredited nonprofit school. New applicants needed at least two years of full-time undergraduate study, 3.2 GPA and 50 hours of service. Vocational schools can qualify under the prior rules. AIM NJ’s 21-month certificate does not establish the formal two-year duration or nonprofit condition. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Mark G. Molzon Vocational Scholarship
entry.summary: Red Bank Elks Lodge #233 — $1,000 one time. New Jersey residents who are graduating high-school seniors and plan to attend a postsecondary vocational or technical certificate or credential program. A two-year community college is allowed for certificate study. The award excludes study toward an associate or bachelor’s degree. Incoming AIM NJ students can check certificate fit. Current AIM enrollment alone does not satisfy the high-school senior requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Duncan Aviation 2027 Paid Maintenance Internships
entry.summary: Duncan Aviation — Paid internship · rate unpublished. Current maintenance students can apply for Airframe and Structures roles requiring enrollment in an airframe maintenance or related program, with high-school completion or equivalent. The Provo Airframe posting accepts current aviation maintenance students. The cited airframe roles do not list a completed college degree or A&P as a requirement. Driver’s license and role-specific tools, lift qualification and physical requirements apply. Avionics roles can require electronics or avionics enrollment. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: EOD Warrior Foundation Scholarship · GI Bill–approved trade school
entry.summary: EOD Warrior Foundation — Amount unpublished in current application. For eligible dependents of Naval School Explosive Ordnance Disposal graduates. The current application explicitly includes a GI Bill–approved trade-school route and asks the sponsor for proof of graduation or DD-214. No completed degree or specific major is stated for that route. The VA lists AIM Teterboro. Confirm the exact A&P program and enrollment with the foundation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: National FFA Scholarships · shared application
entry.summary: National FFA Organization — Varies by donor. Current FFA membership and full-time active study required. Applicants must be high-school seniors or college freshmen, sophomores or juniors, under 23, planning U.S. postsecondary or trade study. The shared program includes vocational certificates and two- or four-year degree pathways. Donor-specific fields and education rules apply. Current AIM NJ certificate enrollment alone does not establish a qualifying class year or donor match. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Teamsters Scholarship Fund · vocational and degree routes
entry.summary: International Brotherhood of Teamsters — $2,000 one-time scholarship. Qualifying children and financial dependents of Teamsters members in good standing. Spouses are excluded. The 2027 FAQ accepts qualifying graduating high-school seniors, GED holders and community-college transfers. It advertises trade and vocational study but specifies associate programs for the non-baccalaureate route. AIM NJ’s nondegree certificate is outside that published route. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Two Ten Footwear Foundation · shared scholarships
entry.summary: Two Ten Footwear Foundation — $4,000–$5,000 per year by route. Eligible U.S. footwear employees or legal dependents generally need at least 24 months of qualifying employment, GPA 2.5 and FAFSA financial-need documentation. Separate routes include footwear military families and qualifying National Shoe Travelers members, dependents or grandchildren. The sponsor describes accredited vocational training through a first certification, and also lists associate and bachelor’s degrees. Graduate study is excluded. Confirm standalone AIM NJ certificate acceptance and prior-degree treatment. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: AGC Workforce Development Scholarship · construction trades
entry.summary: AGC Education and Research Foundation — $1,000 per year. For current or prospective part- or full-time students pursuing a construction career through an approved craft program, registered apprenticeship or accredited construction-related degree, certificate or credential. No completed degree is required. AIM NJ’s aircraft maintenance certificate is outside the published construction field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: TRADESTRONG Construction Trades Scholarship
entry.summary: The TRADESTRONG Foundation — $3,000. Current high-school seniors may apply and 2026 graduates may be considered. GPA 2.2 minimum, a vetted school and a listed construction-related trade are required. Diesel technology is listed, including Lincoln Tech as a provider. Confirm whether its South Plainfield, NJ diesel certificate is accepted. The application does not list a required prior degree. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance is outside the listed fields. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Folds of Honor First Responder Higher Education Scholarship
entry.summary: Folds of Honor — Up to $5,000. Qualifying spouse or dependent child of a fallen or catastrophically injured first responder. The provider accepts qualifying technical or trade study and says a second trade certification can receive funds. Prior degrees do not automatically exclude applicants. Confirm the institution and program with the sponsor. Requires proof of relationship, service and injury or death, plus eligible unmet need. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Start Strong Scholarship · Monmouth and Ocean foster youth
entry.summary: The Village Foster Closet — $500–$2,000 typical. Current or former foster youth ages 17–25 who live in Monmouth or Ocean County, NJ. Awards can cover trade school, certifications, tuition, required tools and supplies, as well as certain job-start or housing costs. The provider lists no specific major or completed degree. A qualifying AIM NJ student may request eligible costs. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: AWS National Scholarships · welding and related study
entry.summary: American Welding Society Foundation — $2,500–$10,000+ by donor. The national program is primarily for current or prospective associate or bachelor’s students in welding or a related discipline. Named awards include women-in-welding options with donor-specific criteria. Confirm the individual award before relying on a certificate or prior degree. General AIM NJ A&P certificate enrollment does not meet the published national degree and field description. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Lisa Michelle Memorial Fund Scholarship
entry.summary: The Lisa Michelle Memorial Fund — $250–$1,000. U.S. or Canadian citizen living in the U.S. or Canada. Trade-school, college and university students may apply in any major, including an eligible AIM NJ certificate. Full- or part-time enrollment and a 3.0 cumulative GPA are required. A listed close family member must have died due to substance abuse. No prior degree is required. Previous winners are excluded. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Follow Your Own Path Essay Scholarship
entry.summary: Scholarships360 — $1,000. Current students in technical, vocational or certificate programs can apply, including AIM NJ A&P certificate students who meet the individual rules. U.S. citizenship or permanent residence required. No specific major or completed degree is listed. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Scholarships360 $10,000 No Essay Scholarship
entry.summary: Scholarships360 — $10,000. U.S. citizens or permanent residents in eligible technical or vocational study may apply, including AIM NJ certificate students who meet the sponsor’s rules. Adult learners and other students are eligible. No specific major or completed degree is listed. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Bennie Adkins Scholarship · vocational study
entry.summary: Green Beret Foundation / Bennie Adkins Foundation — Amount varies / unpublished. U.S. Army Special Forces soldiers on active duty, separated within the last five years or retired within the last five years. Applicants must be accepted or enrolled at an accredited vocational institution, college or university. The rules list no specific major or completed degree. Accredited AIM NJ vocational study can fit the stated school category. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Patty Shinseki Army Spouse Scholarship
entry.summary: Army Emergency Relief — Varies with financial need. Eligible DEERS-listed Army spouses and survivors, including specified Title 10 Guard/Reserve families. FAFSA financial need and GPA 2.0 minimum. Full- and part-time study at an accredited eligible institution. The sponsor overview allows first technical certifications, while the application guidelines emphasize a first undergraduate degree. Confirm AIM NJ’s standalone A&P certificate before relying on eligibility. Second bachelor’s degrees are case-by-case. Graduate study is excluded. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: SpouseWorks Scholarship · approved credentials
entry.summary: Military OneSource — Up to $4,000 in tuition assistance. Eligible military spouses across all ranks under qualifying active-duty or Title 10 Guard/Reserve rules. Funding supports approved licenses, certifications, associate degrees and certain continuing education. No completed degree is required. The school and education plan must qualify. AIM NJ campus and program approval are unconfirmed. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Hap Arnold Education Grant · military family
entry.summary: Air & Space Forces Aid Society — Varies with financial need. Eligible children, spouses or surviving spouses of qualifying Air Force or Space Force members. High-school graduate, full-time undergraduate enrollment or acceptance for the award year, GPA 2.0 and federal-aid dependent status. The sponsor expressly includes accredited trade schools approved for federal student aid. Confirm the exact AIM NJ certificate and enrollment schedule. Graduate/professional students and applicants who are themselves veterans or military members are excluded. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Piston Fund Automotive Trades Scholarship
entry.summary: The Piston Foundation — Up to $5,000. Collector-car restoration or service career interest and financial need. Eligible accredited U.S. programs cover automotive or motorsports vehicle technology, automotive restoration or automotive engineering. The rules list bachelor’s, associate and vocational-technical credentials, including certificates. Confirm the sponsor’s two- or four-year wording for a shorter automotive program. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance is outside the listed fields. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: NRAEF Restaurant and Hospitality Scholarships
entry.summary: National Restaurant Association Educational Foundation — $2,500–$10,000. Current part- or full-time study in an accredited postsecondary restaurant, foodservice or hospitality degree program. Prior undergraduate or graduate degree holders can apply if now pursuing a hospitality degree. No general certificate-only route is listed for this application. Some donor awards have narrower school, field or geography rules. AIM NJ’s A&P certificate is outside the degree and field rules. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: CadetInvest Academic Scholarships
entry.summary: Civil Air Patrol — Typically $1,000–$2,500, varies by award. Active CAP cadet in good standing, Billy Mitchell Award or higher, at least a high-school senior at application and age 17 by March 1, 2027. No CAP scholarship received in the prior three years. Show that you have applied or been accepted to a school, and be enrolled during the award year. Several general awards explicitly accept postsecondary vocational or technical education with no completed degree or A&P required. AIM NJ's 21-month A&P certificate can fit that published study category if you meet the individual award rules and attend in the award year. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: IEC Foundation Scholarship · electrical training
entry.summary: Independent Electrical Contractors Foundation — Amount not published. IEC students, members or their immediate families pursuing postsecondary college study or a state-accredited apprenticeship for an electrical career. The New Jersey IEC chapter lists this for its apprentices. The apprenticeship route does not require a completed college degree. Aviation maintenance is outside the verified field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Automotive Women's Alliance Foundation Education Scholarship
entry.summary: Automotive Women's Alliance Foundation — Current award amount not published. North American citizen with college or university acceptance and a 3.0 minimum GPA during the funded semester. The foundation supports women pursuing careers in automotive, vehicular or mobility fields. Its current rules do not specify a degree level, a completed degree requirement or whether a standalone trade certificate qualifies. Confirm a college-based certificate with the sponsor. AIM NJ A&P eligibility is unconfirmed. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Dr. Carolyn Ghazal Dental Assistant Scholarship
entry.summary: PDS Health Foundation — Up to $5,000 toward tuition. Age 18+, high-school diploma or GED, and enrolled in an accredited U.S. vocational dental-assistant certification program through award. High-school programs and previous applicants are excluded. GPA 3.0 or good academic standing. Selection considers financial need and service. No completed college degree is required. AIM NJ aviation maintenance is outside the required field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Essential Visionaries Scholarship Fund
entry.summary: Scholarship America — Up to $5,000 at vocational or two-year schools. U.S. resident who is a high-school senior, high-school or GED graduate, or current undergraduate. GPA 2.5+. Enroll for the full upcoming academic year at an accredited eligible U.S. institution in an undergraduate degree or certificate in education, counseling, social work, psychology, nursing or pre-nursing. Certificates must run at least one term on a standard semester calendar. A K–12 career commitment applies except in nursing. No completed degree is required. Prior-degree applicants should confirm eligibility. AIM NJ aviation maintenance is outside the listed fields. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Veteran Scholarship for Educators
entry.summary: Scholarship America — $1,000 certification or $5,000 vocational/two-year degree. U.S. military veteran honorably discharged and no longer serving or drilling by July 2027. High-school/GED graduate or current postsecondary student, GPA 2.0+, financial need and intent to work in K–12 education, school counseling, school social work or school psychology. Pursue an associate, bachelor's or master's at an accredited eligible school for the full academic year, or a state-approved alternative certification pathway. A completed degree is not required by the scholarship itself. Confirm any degree required by the certification program. AIM NJ A&P is outside the listed fields. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: HVAC HERO Scholarship · in-person trade school
entry.summary: EGIA Foundation — $2,500 toward training costs. U.S. citizen, national or permanent resident with a 2.0 minimum GPA and current or planned enrollment in an accredited in-person HVAC associate degree, diploma or certificate program. Provide program documentation. Employees of EGIA or its foundation and their children are excluded. High-school seniors and ages 18–26 receive preference. No completed college degree is stated. AIM NJ A&P is outside the HVAC program requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Wells Fargo Veterans Emergency Grant
entry.summary: Wells Fargo / Scholarship America — Up to $1,000 for an eligible emergency. Honorably discharged U.S. veteran, including Reserves or National Guard, or a spouse or surviving spouse of an eligible disabled veteran. Use available military education benefits. Be currently enrolled full-time for the full academic year in a first associate, bachelor's or master's degree at an accredited eligible institution, including a vocational-technical school that offers the required degree. GPA 2.0+ and an unexpected expense that threatens continued enrollment are required. Current AIM NJ certificate study alone does not meet the degree rule. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Red Wing Build the Future Scholarship
entry.summary: Red Wing Shoe Company / SkillsUSA — $2,500. 2026–27 SkillsUSA student member and high-school senior or postsecondary student planning eligible spring 2027 study. Accredited trade school, technical or community college, apprenticeship and certificate programs qualify. Aviation Maintenance Technology is explicitly listed, alongside automotive/diesel, building maintenance and industrial technology. No completed degree is required. Confirm AIM NJ chapter membership, continuing-enrollment treatment and the applicable store selection before relying on eligibility. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Fluid Power Scholarship
entry.summary: National Fluid Power Association Education and Technology Foundation — $2,500 for tuition. High-school senior or postsecondary student at an accredited U.S. community college, technical college or university. GPA 2.5+. Must study a program that teaches fluid power. The sponsor lists industrial maintenance, automotive, mechatronics, CNC technician and manufacturing-equipment certificates. Current master's/PhD students and college/university students graduating in spring 2027 are excluded. No prior degree is required. AIM NJ’s certificate and school classification require sponsor confirmation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: NFSF Construction Trades Scholarship
entry.summary: NAWIC Founders’ Scholarship Foundation — Starts at $2,000. Currently enrolled in eligible U.S. construction craft or trade training through an apprenticeship, community college, technical school or equivalent. High-school seniors are eligible. The trades application accepts training/certification without a completed college degree. The separate undergraduate application has degree rules. Donor preferences can vary. AIM NJ aviation maintenance is outside the construction requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Blessons Scholarships for Women · skilled trades
entry.summary: Blessons for Women — Up to $2,000. Women 25+ returning after an interruption to their education, with financial need. At least part-time enrollment in skilled-trade vocational/technical study, continuing education or an associate program. No completed degree is required. The application says regional or ACICS accreditation and accepts U.S. citizens or permanent residents, while the summary refers to U.S. citizens. Confirm permanent-resident eligibility if relevant. AIM NJ is ACCSC-accredited and requires sponsor confirmation under the published accreditation rule. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: SparkForce Manufacturing Scholarships · fall 2027
entry.summary: SparkForce, The FMA Foundation — Up to $2,000 per semester. Manufacturing-related certificate or degree in an approved field such as industrial maintenance, automation, electronics, NDT, welding or precision sheet metal. At least 12 credit hours, or 6 credit hours while working. GPA 2.5+ for trade/community/technical students and 3.0+ for university students. No completed degree required. Sponsor staff, officers and specified relatives are excluded. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance is not listed as an approved field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Don Carrington Vocational and Trade School Scholarship
entry.summary: Rotary Club of Robbinsville Hamilton — $1,000. Graduating high-school senior residing in Mercer County, NJ, who plans to continue at a technical, vocational or trade school. No completed college degree or specific trade is stated. A current AIM NJ student who is already out of high school does not meet this entry-stage requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.
